generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with context/edit-target.jpg first and L2-seed-region-r2-source.png second as reference only

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: No cast shadows or obvious sun angle are present, and the aggregate first-moment proxy is low, but multiple boulders and column tops retain visibly brighter upper facets and darker side facets. The hard equal-value rule is not established.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: The broad coherent open moor counts as buildable; the immediate broken column rim and short rocky banks count as steep; shingle, talus, boulders, scrub, and broken shore ground make up the remainder.
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.limitation: Screen-space visual estimate rather than elevation-derived slope or world-space surface area.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster blue/teal classification expanded through wet neutral and pale foam pixels near classified water, retained only when connected to the sea at a canvas edge, then filled for sub-96-pixel speckle gaps. The mask follows the painted shore rather than a coarse open-water polygon.
water_mask.interior_transparent_land_note: These pixels are exposed offshore stack, skerry, and rock components, not holes in painted water. Ripple highlights, reflections, surf, and wash are opaque water.

crown.method: Complete visual census of the source: the arriving painted heather strip contains no conifers, and no conifer crowns were introduced.

open_risks: Hard edge-topology failure: land reaches 511 pixels of the east edge and 939 pixels of the west edge; the brief requires both edges to be sea. The water mask follows the source and does not conceal this defect.

Hard lighting risk: multiple boulders and column tops show brighter upper facets and darker sides despite the neutral-lighting rule. No cast shadows or coherent sun angle are visible, but equal face value is not met.
The generated shore is a low broken column rim rather than a tall viewer-facing cliff, but some short vertical column faces remain visible at the rim and require human perspective judgment.
The source cannot be corrected without violating the one-edit-call limit. It remains quarantine-only for director and owner review; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
